name: robots/openai__multiagent-competition
title: OpenAI gym-compete run-to-goal-ants-v0 (two ants)
intro: OpenAI gym-compete run-to-goal-ants-v0 (two ants), adapted from openai/multiagent-competition. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
